findings.text: 已有独立部署管理员盘点设备授权、远程入口与退出，不建议新增部署弃用包，见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
本机issue→限时可多次accept窗口→单次landing grant→设备身份→HTTP/WS显式设备门→内层Host认证loopback代理，见 [Q02](#research-q02)。

本组件package/README、Host/client入口；pairing/grant/routes/remote-api/loopback-proxy/inner-auth；gate注册；网络sync、LAN forwarder、tunnel teardown、relay claim/release、client telemetry。未执行或全审Host、移动浏览器、全部Cloudflare ingress/relay云端/OS回收、其他插件和迁移目标。
已弃用的独立原生Host/Web子插件；仅按本项入口判断，不把同仓聚合或其他插件状态当独立执行验收。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 资源/现金 | 人工与未知 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | Host/网络/状态文件 | 兼容与授权盘点，工时未知 |
| 持续 | 带宽/电力/可选云套餐 | 定价/用量未知；仍付Host模型工具费用 |
| 失败 | 可能仍开的流/任务 | 查文件/旧流/公网租约 |
| 退出 | 保留审计/删敏感身份 | 本地关闭不等云端删除 |
仅建议已有部署先静态盘点并退出；不得把配对视为只读授权。必要验证使用隔离脱敏Host，关闭各自动面并核旧流和实际任务，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

#### 效果

| 项目 | 源码支持 | 尚未验证 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 远程Web | 官方shell+真实HTTP/WS代理 | 跨网/当前Host兼容 |
| 设备门 | 新请求/upgrade查活身份 | 已有流及时撤回 |
| 停用 | 多通道各自清理 | 云端/OS/任务全部结束 |
| 使用收益 | 减少手工拼配对代理 | 真实需求/净时间/费用 |
设备门和内层代理真实接通，grant单次消费明确；raw WS生命周期、持久失败、Host gate与多网络出口要求分层验证，见 [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)。
区分配对窗口、单次落地grant、可撤销设备和内层Host认证，复用官方Web而非另造聊天端，见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
新请求撤销不等旧WS断流，pair stop不等停所有网络/任务；设备持久失败与Host gate当前发射仍需验证，且固定版已弃用，见 [Q03](#research-q03)-[Q04](#research-q04)。
device→WS登记并在撤销/idle/stop时关闭本通道旧流；先与当前Host/现有LAN清理对照，无剩余需求或误断负担更大即否定，见 [Q06](#research-q06)。

#### 依赖

| 条件 | 用途 | 边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 匹配DSH/Node与成品 | Host/Web入口 | 声明不等运行通过 |
| Host connection/authenticatedUrl | 内层cookie/官方页面 | 当前Host全路径gate未验 |
| 可写设备文件/受控浏览器 | 配对/持续身份 | bearer凭据，持久失败须查 |
| LAN/可选Cloudflare/relay | 远程通道 | relay默认开，云端未审 |
| 原Host模型/工具权限 | 实际工作 | 配对不提供设备最小权限 |

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)-[Q02](#research-q02)配对/反代成熟，局部整合Host cookie和页面grant，novelty25%超0但无新范式不达50%。mechanism50%，[Q02](#research-q02)设备门到真实loopback代理和grant拆分超25%界面包装，撤销/Host全路径未验不达75%。transferability50%，[Q03](#research-q03)凭据/连接/任务生命周期拆分可迁移超25%局部配置，缺异构验证不达75%。simplification25%，减少手工拼接超0；[Q04](#research-q04)多出口/弃用维护不达50%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)远程用同一Web是访问便利，未证责任/任务组织改变，workflow不达25%。交付仍原Host工作，未建立新交付单元/责任机制，delivery不达25%。没有此前明确受限群体与约束解除证据，移动访问不自动使reach达25%。未改资源供给/服务结构且费用未知，economics不达25%。

recommendation.reason: 已有部署管理员可先盘点这个弃用包的设备授权和网络出口，准备有记录地退出。它整合配对设备与官方 Web 代理，减少手工拼接入口。若不能确认旧连接、云端租约或 Host 任务已处理，应停 Host 并退回本机 Web，迁移目标另行核查。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)已有部署盘点/退出对象明确，50%超25%泛远程用途；真实需求/成品可用未验不达75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)配对/官方Web整合超0无差异，25%；[Q03](#research-q03)旧流与[Q01](#research-q01)弃用限制，不足50%稳定相对优势。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)真实HTTP/WS/持久与退出已查，50%超25%声明；无Host/网络/全部云端与权限实测，不达75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)-[Q05](#research-q05)多通道/凭据/弃用维护重，25%不达50%轻量；静态盘点和停Host退路明确超0。

      "path": "packages/dsh-remote-web-ui/README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-remote-web-ui · Mobile & Cross-Device Remote Web Control for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)\n\nEnglish | [中文](README.zh.md)\n\n> **Deprecation notice**: `@linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui` is deprecated in favor of [@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge](../dsh-remote-bridge/README.md). It has been retired from the `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` aggregate bundle (where legacy profile rows mount silently as no-ops via tombstone exports and the `retiredPlugins` registry) and will be removed in the next release. Standalone installation (`dsh plugin --profile <name> add @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui`) remains functional during this transitional period. Browser-based remote control has been replaced by the native phone app (@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge), and this package no longer provides remote access capabilities.\n>\n> - **Capabilities migrated to `@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge`**: Ingress stack (relay registry identity, lease control claim/release, quick and named tunnel connectors, Durable Object relay bridge connector, cloudflared lifecycle management and orphan process reaping, Cloudflare named tunnel ingress sync, LAN forwarder, host bind capability probe, and host firewall management).\n> - **Capabilities retired with this package**: Browser-facing remote web control (pairing cookie gate, `/api/pair` endpoints, `/remote` proxy channel, and the mobile browser touch adaptation layer).\n> - **Known coexistence risk**: if installed in the same profile alongside `@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge`, do not enable relay on both plugins simultaneously (both share the same on-disk relay identity per profile; running both causes Durable Object connection contention, and mounting the bridge with `relay=false` withdraws the shared registration row and releases the lease).\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui?style=flat-square\" alt=\"Version\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.2--rc.1-4c6ef5?style=flat-square&labelColor=454a54\" alt=\"DSH\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square\" alt=\"License\">\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>Mobile & Cross-Device Remote Web Control for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)</strong><br>\n  <em>Instant QR Pairing · Cross-Device PC Access · Mobile Touch Gestures · Cloudflare Tunnels · Secure Device Session</em>\n</p>\n\n> Seamless remote access for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and desktop client sharing the **exact same interface**: pair an iPhone, Android smartphone, tablet, or another computer from the QR code next to settings. Both ends run the authentic official Web GUI — phones receive an injected portrait touch layer while remote computers enjoy the complete desktop workbench. Access is guarded by expiring pairing tokens and revocable sessions. Built-in LAN binding and optional Cloudflare quick tunnels enable effortless external access with persistent hostnames.\n\nThis package is an official external plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), structured as a cordis bundle: the host half manages pairing tokens, device sessions, `/api/pair` routes, the gated `/remote` channel, and LAN binding; the browser half renders the remote access trigger, QR pairing modal, live device roster, settings card, and mobile portrait touch adaptation.\n\n## What it does\n\n- **Entry**: a phone icon beside the settings button in both the expanded sidebar and the narrow rail; its tooltip and accessible label say \"Remote access\".\n- **Panel**: \"Remote access\" title, a \"Pair a device\" card with the status area (\"Waiting for a device\" + status badge), a large QR code, the pairing link with its copy button, Stop / Refresh QR actions, and the authorized-device roster (a saved device name that falls back to the User-Agent-derived label, online/offline, last active time, per-device rename and unpair, and a merge action for rows sharing one User-Agent). Credential-bearing device ids and raw User-Agent values are never rendered. Both the phone and the PC use the same time-limited link: until it expires or the QR is refreshed, that link can pair several devices, each with its own device session.\n- **Phone side**: scanning the QR binds the phone with a time-limited token and reloads into the **official Web GUI** — there is no second interface to drift from. While the phone is in portrait, the plugin injects a touch-adaptation layer over the running UI (see \"The mobile adaptation layer\" below). The accept chain is cookieless (`/pair-accept` → `/pair-app`): the plugin itself serves the official shell, so the phone needs no harness browser-auth cookie at all. A reopen service worker (https origins) then owns later navigations to `/` from history, bookmarks, or tab restore, so the phone reopens straight into the app instead of a 401 dead end (see Security model).\n- **PC side**: the same link opens the full desktop Web GUI on another computer over the gated `/remote` channel; unpaired PCs see a guided blocking page (with a manual pair-token input) and no workspace data behind it.\n- **Security**: one active token at a time (a refresh invalidates the old link; the link stays re-usable within its expiry window so a scan handed between browsers can complete pairing; it expires). 停止 revokes every paired device and the current token — the `/remote` channel cuts them off on their next request. Pairing is this plugin's access control for the `/remote` channel; the web server keeps its loopback bind, so a LAN browser reaches the app through this plugin's gated `/remote` gateway (the client moves its transport there) rather than the native `/api`, which the harness Host fence answers with 403 for a LAN authority (see Security model). Loopback (127.0.0.1) keeps using `/api` directly, and so does a page an application on this machine delivered — the desktop shell's `dsh-app://app/` or a `file:` page — because a pairing link is reachable only over the network. A paired device is a **full-control credential** (see Security model).\n- **LAN access toggle (runtime forwarder)**: the settings card starts a forwarder instead of touching any file. The web server keeps its loopback bind, and the forwarder listens on this machine's LAN IPv4 address at the same port, re-issuing every request — HTTP and WebSocket upgrades alike — to `127.0.0.1:<port>`. `--host`/`--port` keep their ordinary meaning, so an explicit `dsh web --host <a LAN address>` still works and the forwarder then yields the port. The toggle applies while the process runs: no restart, no profile edit. When this machine has no LAN IPv4 address the forwarder stays off and the card says so. It maintains the matching host firewall rule (Windows Defender via netsh; Linux firewalld/ufw/iptables; other platforms report the firewall as unmanaged) and shows the live bind, the reachable LAN URLs, the forwarder state (`forward { listening, host, port, reason, error }`) beside the host's own `localBindHost`, and the firewall state.\n- **Live status**: the desktop badge flips to 已连接 in real time; an `/api` posture probe reports any host whose `/api` fence the SDK leaves open, and the auto-tunnel state appears on the panel while the tunnel is starting.\n- **No update trigger on this seat**: the family self-update package that once shared this sidebar foot seat has been removed; plugin updates now come from the official Plugins page version check, so turning remote access off or disabling this plugin never removes them.\n- **Desktop foot row**: on the wide sidebar the footer-action occupants share the official Settings trigger's line instead of stacking above it, so no single control owns a full-width row; any other foot block (the usage glance card, another plugin's) keeps a full row above them, and the 56px rail keeps the shell's stacked foot.\n\n## The mobile adaptation layer\n\nThe official desktop layout already auto-collapses the sidebar below 1024px. On top of that, while the viewport is portrait + coarse pointer + narrower than 1100px the plugin injects:\n\n- a CSS sheet keyed on CSS-Modules **semantic suffixes** (`[class$=\"_composerSeat\"]`) so the selectors survive official rebuilds that only change hashes: 44px touch targets on the collapsed rail, 16px inputs (prevents iOS focus zoom), safe-area padding for the composer, compact type for the message list and sidebar, a column layout for the settings modal, and a full-width PlanReview card;\n- a **draggable whale button** as the entry to the collapsed sidebar (position persisted; wired to the official `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`), hidden while the sidebar is expanded;\n- **gestures**: left-swipe collapses the sidebar, right-swipe in the conversation opens it; long-pressing a session row opens the same action menu as the desktop ellipsis; tapping a session row or anywhere outside the sidebar collapses it again;\n- **input behavior for touch**: Enter only inserts a newline (send goes through the send button), programmatic composer focus is suppressed (no spurious keyboards), and official tooltip bubbles are hidden because taps leave them stuck;\n- **mobile plugin scope**: while the layer is active, the right-hand details column and the desktop-oriented tool surfaces (SSH terminal, skill explorer, task board, git graph, pet, usage) are hidden - keyed on the L2 semantic roots (`data-dsh-plugin`), so ownership stays with the declaring plugin and class churn cannot resurrect them. These are render suppressions; the client bundles still load. Activation also closes the details panel through the official `ctx.layout.closeDetails()`.\n- a **manual opt-out**: `sessionStorage.dsh-remote-force-desktop = 1` disables the whole layer; landscape, desktop, and wide viewports are never touched.\n\nThe paired remote desktop also runs in **host mode**: on this harness line the \"configuration plane is local\" behavior is a client-side branch on `connection.isLoopback`, and the channel boot script installs the transport hook (`__DSH_TRANSPORT__.ownsHost = true`) before any boot entry. Host mode is **server-granted**: the hook is installed only when the device-gated app landing (`/pair-app`) published the grant marker ahead of the boot patch, so a shell served to an unpaired browser — a fence-open deployment — never poses as the machine owner. Settings, credentials, agent presets, and deliverables therefore work on the phone exactly as on the desktop — every call still rides the gated `/remote` channel. Three control planes stay physically local: `/api/pair/*`, `/api/update/*`, and `/api/plugin-manager/*`.\n\n## Requirements\n\n- A DSH installation whose `dsh` CLI supports profiles (`dsh --profile`, `dsh plugin`) — the profile/bundle mechanism this package rides on.\n- For LAN use, either flip the **局域网访问** toggle in the settings card — it listens at once on this machine's current LAN IPv4 address at the web server's port, so after a network change flip it off and on again — or start with `dsh web --host <a LAN address of this machine>`. A wildcard `--host 0.0.0.0` works only on a host that still accepts it; DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and later refuses it outright. With the default `127.0.0.1` bind the panel shows an explicit explanation instead of a dead QR code — unless a public base URL is configured (see \"Remote access over the internet\" below), which makes the QR reachable from anywhere without rebinding, after which a phone on the same network is moved off the tunnel onto the LAN origin by the landing page. The panel's mint/stop endpoints are loopback-only by design: a desktop browser opened at the LAN URL sees a \"配对面板仅限本机使用\" banner.\n- For the one-click public tunnel (`autoTunnel`), the `cloudflared` platform binary ships with the package (its postinstall downloads it; a runtime download covers installers that skip postinstall scripts). No user-side tooling, account, or domain is needed.\n- The same binary also powers the fixed-hostname named-tunnel mode (`tunnelToken`): the public hostname never changes, so a paired phone keeps its bookmark and its pairing cookie across restarts and never re-pairs.\n\n## Install\n\nInstall the family aggregate package `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` (all plugins and skins in one) or this plugin alone:\n\n```sh\n# Recommended: install directly from npm\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui@latest\n\n# Or from the repository (development loop)\ngit clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git\ncd dsh-web\npnpm install && pnpm -r build\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-remote-web-ui\n```\n\nRestart the profile (`dsh web`), then open the phone icon in the sidebar foot. Monorepo subpackages use the `link:` form above.\n\n## Use\n\n1. Open the settings card (设置 → Web 插件 → 远程访问) and flip **局域网访问** on; the card shows the live bind, the forwarder state beside the host's own `localBindHost`, the firewall state, and the reachable LAN URLs, and it says why the LAN entry is off when this machine has no LAN address. The forwarder starts and stops at once, with no restart: after a network change, flip the toggle off and on again so it follows the machine's new address.\n2. Start `dsh web`, click the phone icon, and the panel mints a fresh time-limited QR.\n3. Scan with the phone (or open the copied link): the device pairs and boots the **official Web GUI** served cookieless by the plugin (`/pair-accept` → `/pair-app`), which reloads into `/`. When the link names the public base, the landing page also probes the advertised LAN origins (one short no-cors request to `/pair-ping` per candidate) and moves the phone to the first one that answers, remembering the decision for the session: the public page it was served from stays usable throughout, so the probe never blocks pairing, and a phone that is not on that network simply stays where it is. On a phone, the portrait adaptation layer is already active — same layout as the desktop, same live state. Later reopens from history or a bookmark go straight back into the app (https origins; see Security model).\n4. **To pair a PC instead**: copy the same link and open it in a browser on the other computer. After the same round trip the full Web GUI runs there over the gated `/remote` channel; unpaired PCs see the guided blocking page and no data. One active token pairs one device; mint a fresh QR for the next device.\n5. The desktop badge flips to 已连接 in real time; the device roster lists the paired devices with per-device 取消配对, and 停止 revokes everything.\n6. Configure pairing lifetime, device limits, the LAN fence policy (`requirePairingForLan`), the public base URL, the auto tunnel, the stable-hostname relay, and the named-tunnel token in the same settings card. Which network the pair traverses needs no choice: the QR link names the public base and the landing page moves a same-network phone to a LAN origin by itself. If that probe ever misjudges, pin it with the patch-only `pairingSource` key (`auto` | `public` | `lan`); the card carries no control for it, so a save from the card leaves it alone.\n\n## Remote access over the internet (tunnels)\n\nA tunnel process restart — most often a mobile network dropping and reconnecting — used to drop the public host from the pairing fence the moment the tunnel left `running`, so the address still printed in the QR code answered 403, including on the deliberately public `/api/pair/status` (issue #1547). A named tunnel's fixed hostname and a registered relay origin never change, so both now stay trusted throughout the reconnect; a quick tunnel's previous host stays trusted for a 60 s grace window, because the edge may still be delivering a connection the phone already opened, and is dropped only if the tunnel has not come back by then.\n\n### One-click public tunnel (recommended)\n\nSet **自动公网隧道** (autoTunnel) in the settings card. The plugin runs its own Cloudflare quick tunnel (`cloudflared` ships with the package), feeds the minted public URL into the QR base and the pairing fence dynamically, and keeps the posture probe informed — a phone anywhere can pair at any time. The manual public address and the named-tunnel token below are ignored while this is on. The minted hostname is ephemeral and changes on every `dsh web` restart — the stable-hostname relay below keeps the phone's origin fixed across those restarts. A host that dies without tearing its tunnel down leaves the `cloudflared` child running, so each start reaps the child it recorded (pid plus an exactly matching command line) and never a process it did not start itself.\n\n### Stable-hostname relay (default on; pair once across restarts)\n\nWhile the quick tunnel runs, the plugin additionally registers its current tunnel URL with the dsh-market relay registry and rebuilds the QR on a fixed origin — `https://<id>.dsh-market.com` — minted once per profile and stored under `$DSH_HOME/remote-web-ui-registry/`. The hostname never changes, so the phone's bookmark and its pairing cookie keep working across `dsh web` restarts with no Cloudflare account, no dashboard, and no domain of your own.\n\n- Registration is secret-authenticated: the plugin mints a 256-bit secret next to the identity and re-syncs the mapping on every tunnel start (crash restarts included) with capped backoff. If the registry is unreachable, the QR falls back to the raw quick URL for that session and the panel says so.\n- A phone opening the stable origin while the instance is offline sees an explicit \"instance offline — refresh in a moment, no re-pairing needed\" page instead of a dead link.\n- Turn **固定域名中继** (relay) off in the settings card to keep the deployment entirely on the ephemeral origin; the registry row is removed at once. Trust note: relayed traffic transits the dsh-market edge (a Cloudflare Worker operated by the package author) — see Security model.\n- The relay control plane is additive: whenever the relay is on and the web server port is bound, the plugin claims a named-tunnel lease from `https://dsh-market.com/api/relay/claim` — the worker finds or creates the tunnel named `dsh-relay-<id>`, writes its ingress (catch-all rule included) and an exact proxied CNAME, and hands back that instance's own tunnel token. A lease an operator flipped to the bridge transport converges nothing in the account: that claim creates no tunnel, no ingress and no CNAME, sends no Cloudflare API call at all, keeps only the hostname and the bridge grant, and answers no `tunnel` block — the bridge's data plane is the instance's own Durable Object, so there is nothing to build and nothing to count against the account's 1 000-tunnel quota. The plugin then runs a named connector on the same hostname beside the quick connector; the `mode` the control plane answers names the one the phone is served from, so neither the switch nor its rollback needs a plugin restart. A failed claim is not fatal: the quick tunnel and the origin the registry already gave the phone keep serving, and the claim retries with capped backoff (`502` carries `retryAfterMs`). Turning the toggle off only `release`s the lease (the tunnel and the DNS record stay, so re-enabling is instant); only an explicit `retire` or the 90-day idle cron recovers the source.\n- The bridge transport rides the same lease: the plugin dials `wss://dsh-market.com/api/relay/bridge?id=<id>` with the lease secret in the `Authorization` header and serves every bridged request and phone WebSocket from that one socket, forwarding the public origin as `Host` and never the loopback authority it dials. It idles while the control plane answers `mode=quick`; with no connector attached the Worker falls back to the quick path inside the same request and marks the answer `x-relay-fallback: no-connector`. Because the claim is the only answer that carries the bridge grant, it does not wait for a quick tunnel: an instance served over the bridge reaches its object with `autoTunnel` off. The connector keeps its state in `$DSH_HOME/remote-web-ui-relay-bridge.json` — state, instance, endpoint, local upstream and the last dial error — so a connector that never attached is readable without the host log.\n\n### Fixed-hostname named tunnel (bring your own domain)\n\nThe relay above already fixes the phone's origin on a shared dsh-market subdomain. A Cloudflare named tunnel is the alternative for deployments that want a hostname on **their own** domain: its public hostname is permanent, so the phone's bookmark and its pairing cookie keep working across `dsh web` restarts — pair once, never again (until the session idles past `idleExpireMs`).\n\n1. In the Cloudflare dashboard create a Tunnel and map a public hostname — e.g. `dsh.example.com` — to `http://127.0.0.1:3080` (the port `dsh web` listens on).\n2. Copy the tunnel's token and paste it into **固定域名隧道令牌** (tunnelToken) in the settings card.\n3. Set the same hostname as **公网地址** (publicBaseUrl). The token does not carry the hostname, so without this step the tunnel stays off and a warning names the missing piece.\n\nThe plugin then runs `cloudflared tunnel run --token` with the same lifecycle management as the quick tunnel: the binary ships with the package, unexpected exits restart with backoff, a running tunnel's public URL is probed every 60 s and two consecutive failures mint a fresh tunnel through that same restart path, and the posture probe audits the `/api` fence for the fixed host. The token is stored as a settings secret and read back redacted. The auto quick tunnel takes precedence while it is on.\n\nA `running` tunnel is not a terminal state: a connector that lost its Cloudflare edge registration keeps its process and its metrics port alive while the minted hostname stops resolving, so the plugin used to report `running` indefinitely and the relay kept forwarding the phone to the dead address (Cloudflare 530 / Error 1016) instead of the relay's offline page (issue #1723). The readiness watchdog now treats a public URL that stops answering — DNS failure, refused connection, or a Cloudflare 5xx such as 530 — as a dead tunnel after two consecutive probes, and the ordinary backoff restart mints a new URL and re-registers the relay. An unauthenticated `401`/`403` answer still counts as alive, because that is a healthy round trip to a harness that has not been paired yet.\n\n#### Keeping the ingress port in sync (optional, update-only)\n\nA named tunnel's hostname is permanent, but its ingress rule names a fixed local port (`http://127.0.0.1:3080` above). When `dsh web` later listens on another port — an operator `--port`, another profile, a second instance on the old one — the hostname still resolves and answers 502 while everything in this plugin still believes the address is published. Turn on **Cloudflare config sync** (`ingressSync`) with an account-level API token (`cfApiToken`), the `cfAccountId` and the `cfTunnelId`, and the plugin keeps that one number following the port it actually bound:\n\n- one read on start; the document is written only when the matched rule's service has drifted from the bound port;\n- only the `service` of the rule whose hostname exactly equals `publicBaseUrl`'s host is touched — one full-document PUT, because the API has no single-rule patch, with every other rule and every top-level key proven identical first;\n- a document it cannot prove that about is reported and never written: a missing or duplicated hostname, a wildcard anywhere, an `ingress` that is not an array, a missing catch-all, a service that is not an http(s) origin, or a service hosted anywhere but on this machine — only loopback literals (127.0.0.0/8, `::1`, `localhost`) and this host's own LAN addresses are retargeted, so a neighbour's address or a DNS name is never touched. No rule is added and no catch-all is invented;\n- the write is read back once. A disagreement is a conflict and stops there: one tunnel document has one writer, so a deployment whose dashboard or another sync owns it is reconciled by hand;\n- the bound port is the target: before the listener binds nothing is requested (the same settle re-plan that starts the quick tunnel delivers it), and the tunnel token's own format is never parsed.\n\nThe state frame reports `off`/`waiting`/`applied`/`failed`/`conflict` with the hostname, the port, the two service strings and the reason, and the settings card renders it beside the switch. The quick tunnel takes precedence: with `autoTunnel` on there is no named tunnel to update and the sync reads as off.\n\n### Manual tunnels (bring your own)\n\nExpose the local port with any tunnel and set **公网地址** (publicBaseUrl), e.g.:\n\n```sh\n# 1. Expose the local port (whatever dsh web is listening on):\ncloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:3080\n#    prints something like: https://xxxx-xxxx-xxxx.trycloudflare.com\n\n# 2. Start dsh web as usual. Do not add --trusted-host for the tunnel\n#    domain unless you intentionally want the SDK to trust that host for\n#    /api. Keep the LAN bind off if only tunnel access is wanted.\n```\n\nThen set the printed URL as 公网地址. The QR link is built from it, and the plugin's pairing fence accepts the tunneled authority. The posture probe keeps auditing which `/api` authorities the SDK fence leaves open.\n\n## Development\n\nWork from this repository (no sibling checkout needed):\n\n```sh\ncd dsh-web\nexport NPM_TOKEN='<token>'   # only if private @deepseek-ai auth is still required\npnpm install\npnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui run build\npnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui test\npnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui run typecheck\n```\n\nThe peer APIs come from the official NPM SDK: every `@deepseek-ai/*` package used here is declared in devDependencies (0.2.2-rc.1 cohort), and TypeScript/Vitest resolve types straight from node_modules — no DSH source checkout is required. The consumer-side `prepare` build (`tsdown.prepare.config.ts`) transpiles without type checking, so git installs work without any harness checkout either.\n\n## Checks\n\n```sh\npnpm run typecheck\npnpm test\npnpm run build\n```\n\n## Harness contract dependencies\n\nPinned to the 0.2.2-rc.1 line; the seams this build relies on:\n\n- **`sidebar.footer.action` foot seat** (the 0.1.7 shell composition): the sidebar declares and renders the seat the remote entry occupies.\n- **`ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`** (packages/client/ui-layout): the whale button expands the collapsed sidebar through the official panel-action face.\n- **`ctx.connection.authenticatedUrl()`** (packages/client/connection): the sanctioned launch-token seam the proxy redeems once for its inner credential (`src/inner-auth.ts`), so re-issued `/api` calls satisfy the harness browser-auth check.\n- **`__DSH_FILE_UPLOAD__`** (file-upload client hooks): the optional pre-Cordis transport the upload service reads once at construction. It is installed only when the device-gated app landing published the `__DSH_REMOTE_HOST_GRANT__` marker ahead of the boot patch, so the flip is server-granted rather than asserted from the origin. The loopback question is split in two there: `isLoopbackUpstream` (loopback socket and Host, forwarding headers ignored) only decides whether a Host can be answered at all, while `isLoopbackClient` (no forwarding header) decides who receives a credential or the desktop payload. The shared copy in `shared/host/loopback.ts` keeps `isLoopbackRequest` refusing every forwarded request and adds `isForwardedLoopbackRequest` for the narrower shape a route family may admit behind its own default-off switch.\n\n## Manual E2E: LAN pairing round trip\n\nThe unit/component specs cover the route family, the gate, the channel, the LAN forwarder with its status frame, and the adaptation layer, but the pairing loop involves a real browser on a non-loopback origin. Repeat this after any change to the wire contract or the connection loop:\n\n1. Start an isolated instance: `DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-qa dsh --profile web --no-open --port 3191`; open the card at `http://127.0.0.1:3191`, flip **局域网访问** on, and confirm the card reports the forwarder listening on the machine's LAN IPv4 at 3191.\n2. Open the **loopback** URL (`http://127.0.0.1:3191`) in a browser: the phone icon sits in the sidebar foot; the panel mints a QR whose link is `<lan-url>/pair-accept?pair=<token>`. With a public base configured the link names that origin instead — reachable from anywhere — and the landing does the network choice described under **Use**.\n3. In a second tab under mobile emulation (390x844, touch) open that link: the chain `/pair-accept → /pair-app?grant=<one-time> → /` on an https origin, ending at `/pair-app` instead over plain-HTTP LAN, sets the device cookie, spends the grant, serves the patched official shell, and boots the UI — `document.body.classList` carries `dsh-remote-portrait`, the adaptation stylesheet and the whale button exist, and `__DSH_TRANSPORT__.ownsHost` is `true`. The settings surface renders host data (host mode), not a memory mirror. In an https deployment the shell also registers the reopen service worker (`/pair-app.sw.js`); reloading `/` in that tab boots the app instead of the harness 401. Over plain-HTTP LAN the same tab reloads `/pair-app` and boots the app from the pairing cookie instead.\n4. The desktop badge flips to 已连接 in real time; a LAN-origin desktop page instead shows the 配对面板仅限本机使用 banner and opens no status stream.\n5. 停止 on the desktop cuts the device off: its next request 403s with `unpaired` (the fence page offers the manual pair-token input).\n\nThe public path is the same round trip through a tunnel (see \"Remote access over the internet\"): loopback mint → device opens the public QR URL → accept → official UI, and when the advertised LAN origin actually answers (check with `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://<lan-ip>:<port>/pair-ping`, expecting 204) the landing replaces itself with `http://<lan-ip>:<port>/pair-app?grant=<one-time>` and the UI boots from the LAN origin. Re-scanning the public QR within the same session lands on the public source again, because the decision records the failed switch. Only `publicBaseUrl` (plugin config) names the tunneled host; `--trusted-host` is not part of this pairing flow. The desktop panel still opens at `http://127.0.0.1`.\n\n## Security model\n\n- **Pairing is the access control for the `/remote` channel, unconditionally**: every request must carry a live paired-device cookie, enforced before any bytes are forwarded. A missing or revoked session receives HTTP 403 with a JSON rejection carrying `error.code: \"unpaired\"`; the browser's `EventSource` API exposes only the stream failure, not that response body. This gate does **not** follow `requirePairingForLan`: the channel re-issues every call with the process's own browser-auth credential, so admitting an unpaired caller would hand out that authority. The LAN policy governs the plain `/api` surface only and can never widen the channel (issue #1665).\n- **The channel carries the process's own inner credential.** The harness browser-auth cookie is authority-bound (minted for the exact `host:port` a browser visited) and has no loopback exemption, so a proxied re-issue to `127.0.0.1` cannot reuse a device's cookie. The plugin therefore redeems its own launch token once — the same exchange a first browser visit performs — and attaches that cookie to re-issued requests. The credential is only ever exercised behind the pairing gate above; 停止/取消配对 immediately stop exercising it.\n\n- **The channel forwards the caller's own request headers, and keeps only what it owns (issue #1925).** A plugin may authenticate its own calls with a header of its own — `x-dsh-im-connect-client` on `@michengai/dsh-im-connect`'s `/sessions/ensure` is the reported case — so the re-issue no longer rebuilds the request from a fixed allowlist: every header is forwarded except the ones this channel owns. It rewrites `host` to the loopback authority, replaces the caller's cookie with the process's inner credential, synthesizes `sec-fetch-site: same-origin`, and drops `origin`/`referer`, the whole browser fetch-metadata family (`sec-*`), hop-by-hop headers (including the ones the caller nominates in its own `Connection` header), the forwarding marks (`x-forwarded-*`, `cf-connecting-ip`, `forwarded`, `x-real-ip` — a re-issued request is loopback, and an edge's stamp would fence it as remote), and the cookieless device credential `x-dsh-remote-device`, which the gate consumes and never hands further. `accept-encoding`, `range` and `if-range` stay out as well, because the response headers the proxy copies carry neither `content-encoding` nor `content-range`.\n- **Runtime reality: a LAN browser rides the `/remote` gateway, not the native `/api`.** This plugin never rebinds the web server, so the host stays on `127.0.0.1` and the harness's `/api` Host fence answers a LAN authority with 403. The forwarder makes the host reachable from the LAN, but only this plugin's own surfaces answer there: the pairing entry pages, the status view, and the gated `/remote` channel. Restoring native `/api` over a LAN authority needs the harness web server's `trustedHosts`, which is outside this package; an operator who binds the host to the network with `--host` gets that surface under the harness fence alone, because nothing in the official runtime emits the `api/gate` seam (verified against the 0.2.2-rc.1 packages installed by this repository). On such a deployment a browser credential a device has already redeemed survives 停止/取消配对 until its natural expiry (30 days) — revocation binds the `/remote` channel and the pairing cookie, not that credential. The plugin probes the `/api` posture and warns loudly; treat a network-exposed host bind as a deliberate decision, and prefer loopback plus tunnels when the machine is shared.\n- **A paired device is a full-control credential.** With host mode active it reaches the complete host API — chat, sessions, settings, credentials, agent presets, deliverables — mirroring the SDK's own stance that a loopback desktop is trusted. Only the three control planes (pairing, self-update, plugin install/remove) stay physically local. Only pair devices you control; 停止 or per-device 取消配对 revokes immediately.\n- **Control endpoints stay loopback-only; the status view answers a tunnel visitor minimally**: mint/stop/revoke/rename/merge, the device roster, the events stream, and the lan-bind status answer only to a desktop request (loopback socket and loopback Host, no forwarding header), and the gated channel keeps the self-update and plugin-install paths physically local. `/api/pair/status` is reachable through a tunnel, but a forwarded or unpaired caller receives only `{ ok, paired, requirePairingForLan, phase, lanAvailable }`; the full snapshot — token expiry, public tunnel URL, counts — and the per-device roster stay with the desktop. A LAN-origin browser sees the \"配对面板仅限本机使用\" banner.\n- **A forwarding header makes a request remote (issue #1906), and only the operator may narrow that.** A reverse proxy in front of the host — a Cloudflare tunnel, frp, an nginx reverse proxy — dials `127.0.0.1:<port>` and rewrites the Host header to that upstream literal, so the origin sees a loopback socket and a loopback Host for a public request: both halves of the loopback classification hold and the pairing gate would wave it through. The fence therefore treats a request that carries `CF-Connecting-IP` or `X-Forwarded-For` as forwarded and never as local. The rule lives once in `shared/host/loopback.ts` (`isProxiedRequest`, consumed by `isLoopbackRequest`) and is applied by every synced copy. This package splits the question in two (issue #1919): `isLoopbackUpstream` (loopback socket and Host, forwarding headers deliberately ignored) only decides whether a Host can be answered at all, so a tunnel visitor reaches the pairing status and entry pages, while `isLoopbackClient` (no forwarding header) still guards the pairing gate, the `/api/pair` control planes and the desktop payload. No switch in this package admits a forwarded request to a credential-bearing surface; the sibling task-board plugin ships that narrow counter-case as its own default-off switch (`trustForwardedProxy`). A real desktop request (loopback socket, loopback Host, no forwarding header) still classifies as local; the browser same-origin markers are unchanged and still refuse a cross-site fetch. Residual: a proxy that strips both headers puts the request back in the same shape as the desktop, which no header-level rule can separate — configure the proxy to forward `X-Forwarded-For` (Cloudflare and nginx do by default), and note that a locally running process could always forge any header.\n- **Background file uploads ride the channel too.** The official upload service prefers a Web Worker carrier whose own globals no main-thread patch reaches, so the boot patch (and the browser patch as a fallback) publishes the official pre-Cordis hook `__DSH_FILE_UPLOAD__` and hands it the patched `fetch`: the raw `/api/session/uploadFileBinary` POST is rewritten onto `/remote` and carries the device credential exactly like every other gated call. Without the hook a paired browser's uploads bypass the channel and the harness browser-auth fence answers 401 (issue #1580). The hook is only published on non-loopback origins, only while the channel is installed, and never overwrites a hook the page already owns.\n- **The landing URL carries a one-time grant, never the device id.** `/pair-accept` mints a 256-bit, single-consume grant with a 60 s TTL and redirects to `/pair-app?grant=<g>`; the landing spends it — delete-on-attempt, so a replayed or expired grant resolves to nothing — and hands the device id to the shell in its own response. A device id is a live session credential, so it never enters a URL, the address bar, or any log on the redirect path. The pairing cookie is `Secure` whenever the request arrived over TLS (`x-forwarded-proto: https`) and plain over LAN HTTP, where a Secure cookie would simply be dropped by the browser. When a proxy rewrote the Host to its own loopback upstream and a public base URL is configured, the 303 names that public origin instead of the rewritten Host, because the literal the visitor presents is that visitor's loopback rather than this host's (issue #1919).\n- **The app landing is cookieless-optional.** After pairing, the QR lands the device on `/pair-app`, served by this plugin: the official shell is delivered without passing the harness index gate, and the device credential rides a `x-dsh-remote-device` header (fetch) / `device` query (WebSocket upgrades) that the boot patch attaches from sessionStorage. The flow therefore works when the device browser blocks all cookies; the pairing cookie remains the primary credential where the browser stores it, and the harness browser-auth cookie is no longer required on the phone path at all.\n- **A per-instance tunnel token can only run its own tunnel.** The control plane hands the `dsh-relay-<id>` tunnel's token only to a caller that proved possession of that id's secret; the plugin passes it to `cloudflared` through the `TUNNEL_TOKEN` environment variable and never through the command line, a log, or a settings file, so a local `ps` / proc listing cannot read it. A leaked token lets someone serve on that hostname but reaches no instance, no other instance, and no DNS record. The Worker-side Cloudflare API token is an account-level credential (Cloudflare Tunnel edit plus DNS edit on the zone), stored as a Worker secret only, never in the plugin, the settings docs, or a process listing; when it is not configured the claim endpoint fails closed with `503 cf-api-unconfigured` and creates no resource and no lease row.\n- **The ingress-sync API token is a local secret with one network destination**: an account-level Cloudflare API token stored as a redacted settings secret and sent only to `https://api.cloudflare.com` — the default transport refuses any other origin before it builds a request — never to a child process argument, a log line, a status frame, or any browser-visible field. The status frame carries the public hostname, the local port and the two service strings, all of which the operator already has, and nothing derived from the credential. A 401/403 stops the sync instead of retrying it, and no write is ever attempted from a document the plan could not prove differs in exactly one service.\n- **Reopens are owned by a service worker (https origins).** A paired phone returning from history, a bookmark, or tab restore navigates to bare `/` — a path the plugin does not own, where the harness fallback seat answers with its browser-auth 401 (the cookieless flow never holds that credential). The app shell therefore registers `/pair-app.sw.js` (fenced like `/pair-app`; the script is inert logic with no secrets): it intercepts navigations to `/` only, re-serves the shell network-first through `/pair-app` — which re-validates the device cookie and refreshes its presence, so every reopen also keeps the session alive — falls back to the cached shell offline, and passes the navigation through when the plugin no longer answers (a revoked device then sees the harness response or the bilingual re-scan page). Plain-HTTP LAN origins are never secure contexts and never register the worker; there the shell keeps `/pair-app` in the address bar instead, so a refresh, a bookmark, or a tab restore re-validates the device cookie through the same device-gated landing (and reaches the bilingual re-pair page once that pairing is gone).\n- **Revocation is per-request**: a paired device whose request is already in flight when 停止 lands completes that request; the next one 403s.\n- **Paired device sessions persist by default**: device sessions (not the time-limited QR token) are written to `$DSH_HOME/remote-web-ui-devices.json` (0600, temp file + atomic rename). Sessions idle for `idleExpireMs` (default 30 days; the reopen service worker refreshes the window on every navigation it serves) are deleted and must pair again. Device ids are session credentials; a custom device name is display metadata stored in the same file and never participates in authorization. A revocation that cannot be written to disk (read-only DSH_HOME, a full disk) removes the stale store instead of leaving a revoked session on disk, so the next start cannot restore it.\n- **The LAN edge never makes a request look local**: the forwarder discards the client's `Host` and every forwarding header it sends, then stamps the LAN authority it was reached at plus `X-Forwarded-For`, so the loopback upstream leg still arrives as a forwarded request and every fence that decides \"is this the desktop\" refuses it. Failing to take the LAN socket — the address went away after a network change, the port is taken — costs the LAN entry only: the loopback listener is never touched, the failure is logged and reported as `forward.error`, and nothing is written to a file, so a network change needs neither a profile edit nor a restart.\n- **The desktop gate policy is public, and it is not an access control**: `/api/pair/status` exposes only the boolean `requirePairingForLan` policy so a remote desktop can choose the correct transport before its settings scope is available. The switch governs the bare `/api` surface only: turning it off lets an unpaired client use that surface under the harness's own fence, and it never loosens the `/remote` channel, which demands a paired credential unconditionally. This field is not a credential and does not expose tokens, devices, counts, or tunnel URLs; the minimal payload a tunneled caller receives is described under the control-endpoint rule above.\n- **The device credential still rides the WebSocket query.** A WS handshake cannot carry headers from the Web API, so the cookieless credential travels as `?device=<id>`; the plugin's own `/remote` handler consumes it and never forwards it to the inner loopback request, but the origin access log, the relay Worker, and the Cloudflare edge still see a URL that authenticates as that device. Cookie-capable browsers authenticate the handshake by cookie instead. A short-lived single-use WS ticket is the planned replacement.\n- **Quick-tunnel hostnames change per run**: a `trycloudflare.com` URL is random on every `cloudflared` start, so `publicBaseUrl` (or the auto tunnel) must be refreshed with it. The stable-hostname relay pins a fixed `<id>.dsh-market.com` origin in front of that ephemeral URL (default on with the auto tunnel); the named-tunnel mode (`tunnelToken`) is the own-domain alternative. The token itself is stored as a redacted settings secret — never logged, never echoed to the browser half.\n- **The relay moves the origin, not the trust root**: with the relay on, the phone talks to `https://<id>.dsh-market.com`, a dsh-market Cloudflare Worker that looks up the instance's current tunnel URL and forwards request bytes verbatim — the pairing cookie and every application-level check stay on the instance, and the worker never terminates a pairing. What changes is the transit path: the relayed traffic passes infrastructure operated by the package author on Cloudflare's edge, so the author's worker can observe it — the same visibility Cloudflare itself has over a raw `trycloudflare.com` quick tunnel. The registry binds each id to a SHA-256 hash of a 256-bit secret (the plaintext lives only in `$DSH_HOME`, 0600), accepts only `*.trycloudflare.com` targets, rate-limits registrations, and stores nothing but the mapping; turn the relay off to leave the deployment entirely on the ephemeral origin.\n\n## Known Limitations and Deferred Work\n\n- **The LAN entry follows the forwarder, not a profile write**: the toggle starts and stops it while the process runs, so nothing here needs a restart; after a network change, flip it off and on again. A LAN address that has gone away, or a port already taken, costs the LAN entry only — the loopback listener is untouched and the status frame reports `forward.reason` (`off`, `host-bind`, or `no-address`) with `forward.error`.\n- **A legacy managed block is removed once, and one of its shapes still needs a hand**: a block written by this plugin up to 0.4.8 is stripped on the first activation of each process — atomically, only when it is actually there, with the file's permissions preserved and nothing written back — and `legacyBlockRemoved` reports it. The cleanup runs when the plugin activates, so an updated build takes it on the next `dsh web` start. The exception is a block that pinned `0.0.0.0`: DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and later refuse that value before this plugin ever loads, so that host cannot reach the cleanup. Edit the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` once by hand: delete the block's two marker comments (the `# --- remote-web-ui lan-bind block ...` line and the `# --- end remote-web-ui lan-bind block ---` line) and the `- id: webserver` item between them — not the whole marked region, because other plugin rows may sit inside it.\n- **The ingress sync assumes one writer per tunnel document**: it reads, proves, writes and reads back, but the Cloudflare API offers no conditional write, so a concurrent writer (the dashboard open in a browser, another machine running the same sync) can land between the read and the PUT. That write is then one full document that may include the other writer's state, and a read-back that disagrees is reported as `conflict` and never rewritten. Run the sync from one machine per tunnel; a second one shows up in the frame instead of being retried silently. The whole path is covered by offline tests only — the transport is an injected seam, and neither the tests nor this release have driven a real Cloudflare account.\n- **A refused worker registration falls back to the harness gate**: the reopen worker registers only where service workers exist. When an otherwise secure origin refuses it (deployment policy, a hardened browser profile), the address bar has already moved to `/` and a reopen needs a fresh QR; the plain-HTTP LAN path has no such gap, because its shell stays on `/pair-app`.\n- **The adaptation selectors track the official build**: the semantic-suffix strategy survives hash churn but not semantic renames; each official GUI update needs a visual QA pass (per the dsh-LAN reference, these suffixes have been stable across many official releases).\n- **Dev HMR**: `dsh web --dev` polls every roster bundle by path, so rebuilding this package (its own `tsdown --watch`) hot-reloads the client bundle; the host half needs a restart.\n- **A mounted `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` row blocks every settings save**: the official config editor serializes its writes through `hmr.runExclusive` whenever the `hmr` service is mounted, and on this cohort such a write is rejected as a nested transaction - the Host answers `HMR transactions cannot be nested` and each family settings card (and the official settings pages) reports a failed save. The row is user-added (no bundle ships it); a Desktop profile carries it to hot-reload a local plugin's host half. Remove the `- id: hmr` row from the profile patch to restore saves, and re-add it only while iterating on that plugin. Observed on the Desktop client 0.2.1-rc.2 (2026-09-30).\n\n## Dependency rationale\n\n`qrcode.react` (MIT, actively maintained, React 16–19 support) renders the QR as a dependency-free SVG component — no canvas, no server-side image generation. README](packages/dsh-task-board/README.zh.md)）。任务看板不仅仅是一个可视化卡片界面，更是 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Web GUI 与桌面客户端中的**宿主权威后台长程执行与多 Agent 自动化调度引擎**。任务按“待规划、待办、进行中、已完成、已失败”五列进行全生命周期管理，支持项目分区、粘贴文本 AI 解析与卡片多模态附件（每卡最多 8 个图片或文件附件，经官方附件存储 SHA256 核验，执行时图片作为多模态部件入队、文件以只读路径注入），以 Schema v7 事务账本为权威持久化核心，真正实现了长程任务从拆解、父卡自治派发、对抗质检到外部成果闭环的全流程自动化：\n\n- **宿主权威后台驱动与 7x24 小时离线无人值守**：区别于传统仅在前端网页轮询的脆弱看板，所有卡片流转、调度触发与执行监控完全由 DSH 后端 Host 进程作为唯一权威驱动。支持循环 5 字段 Cron 表达式（绑定 IANA 时区与可选 `maxRuns` 次数预算）与单次未来时刻（`once`）两类定时计划；浏览器仅为异步视图，关闭网页标签页、熄灭屏幕或断开网络，后台智能体会话照常并发执行与原子落盘结算。内置跨平台防休眠电源管理（macOS `caffeinate`、Windows `ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED`、带有 systemd-logind 的 Linux `systemd-inhibit`），允许显示器正常关闭的同时阻止整机因闲置休眠，确保夜间无人值守巡检与流水线准时打卡。\n- **树状子任务与父卡自治派发（Subtask Trees & Autonomous Parent Dispatch）**：复杂工程目标可拆解为 1 至 3 层树状子任务（内置环路与深度护栏）。执行任意卡片只为该卡片自身开启**唯一一个**会话，Host 绝不为子任务批量派生独立会话；当执行的卡片存在未完成后代时，Host 自动在本次运行中强制切入 `liangshen`（梁神模式）调度者预设，并在启动 Prompt 中注入未完成子卡清单，由父会话通过 `task_board_get` 逐张读取子卡详情、按依赖顺序通过 `subagent` 自治派发（互不依赖的子任务并发执行），完工前调用 `task_board_manage({ action: 'record-external-outcome' })` 一次性回填各子卡结论（未显式回填的后代由 Host 在父卡终结时幂等兜底结算）。多张独立卡片在同一时刻触发时，由受控准入队列（`runLaunchWidth`，1 至 16，默认 3）治理并发创建会话的宽度。\n- **对抗式双盲质量验收门禁（No False Completion）**：彻底终结 AI 编程中“自述已完成、实则未改动或改崩溃”的虚假交付顽疾。以 goal 形式执行的任务在 Agent 试图调用 `update_goal(complete)` 宣告完工的瞬间被 Host 强制拦截，必须由独立的裁判模型（可自选模型与思考档位）进行真实验收。验收机制沿用严苛的 Coding 质量判据、0.65 绝对通过阈值，每项判据双轮交换 A/B 位置打分消偏，并严格结合会话执行轨迹与宿主工作区真实磁盘文件的 Diff 行级变更审查。首轮未达标精准下发具象结构化问题引导 Agent 自我修复，两次仍不通过才判负，杜绝敷衍糊弄。\n- **GitHub 运行时与高效调度引擎）\n\n在新建会话输入框左侧通过专属老虎机拨杆切换，或在“设置 > Agent 预设”中选用。梁神模式（`dsh-liangshen`）是专为追求**极致推理效率、超低静态上下文开销与严苛工程执行纪律**而深度重构的杀手级预设与运行时插件。针对主流大模型在长程编程任务中容易出现的系统提示词冗长膨胀、工具 Schema 挤占上下文、思维链无效空转（如“流水账推理”）以及多轮遗忘退化等痛点，梁神模式通过原生极简提示词、程序化代码工具调用（PTC）、MCP 温和分页与关键事实局部就近投射，提供纯粹而强悍的编程作战体验：\n\n- **极简 Persona 与严苛行动导向纪律（Zero Prompt Waste）**：彻底剥离官方 Standard 预设中冗长繁琐的系统级条文，将提示词极致收敛为单行 Persona 与经过实战千锤百炼的高效工程纪律。内置反思熔断（同一假设推演不超过两轮，缺少事实立即闭合思考并调用原生工具探测，杜绝凭空揣测）、行动导向（思考过程仅用于决定下一步具体操作，严禁在思考中预演完整代码）、并发探索（单轮内并发派发多个独立检测或搜索工具）、YAGNI 与 PDCA 循环（单步验证单一假设，不写冗余注水注释）、以及有界收敛纪律（前置检查最多 2-3 轮即刻收敛，迅速转入实际作答或编辑）。大幅降低静态 Token 占用，让模型注意力百分之百倾注于业务与代码本身。\n- **程序化工具调用传输（PTC · Programmatic Tool Calling）**：彻底终结在每次请求中平铺上百个 JSON Schema 工具参数的低效模式。默认将网络线协议（wire）极致收拢为唯一的 `run_code`（运行 TypeScript 脚本），其余所有工具均通过自动生成的强类型 SDK 在独立的沙箱线程中以代码形式调用。无论系统注册了多少复杂工具，静态传输面始终保持极小体积；模型可原生利用 `Promise.all` 编写并发工具调用，并在程序内预先过滤、聚合、提取关键数据，只将精炼结论回传至对话上下文，从根本上解决大文本输出打爆 Token 的问题。对于习惯原生工具面的场景，亦可在插件设置中一键无缝切换为组装好的原生工具清单（Native）。\n- **MCP 工具温和分页与 LRU 动态激活（Gentle Tool Paging）**：针对海量 MCP 工具或第三方插件扩展，出厂默认启用温和分页（默认匹配 `mcp__*`）。外部工具在初始状态下仅以命名空间摘要形式登记在目录消息中，既不占 wire 协议也不进 SDK 声明；当大模型判定需要使用对应工具时，可自主调用 `tool_activate({ namespace })` 按需挂载。内置 LRU 策略（上限 3 个活跃命名空间），自动淘汰最久未用的命名空间，激活状态在会话压缩与恢复后完整重建，兼具海量工具接入能力与极致小巧的静态 Schema 面。\n- **关键事实登记簿与就近状态投射（Fact Register & Working Context）**：长程多轮对话中大模型极易遗忘早期的关键业务约束或踩过的坑。插件向模型提供专属 `fact_register` 工具，可将用户硬性约束、已确认的架构决策或失败路径登记为单行事实（每条不超过 160 字符，最多保留 12 条）。关键事实随 `[Working Context: ...]` 状态行在每一轮交互中就近投射至最新消息尾部的局部注意力窗口内，从物理机制上彻底解决长上下文“中间遗忘”与重复踩坑顽疾。\n- **原生调度者架构与敏捷访谈纪律（Dispatcher Identity & Triage）**：预设出厂深度集成调度者（Dispatcher）架构规范，赋能模型以团队指挥官身份统领工程任务。内置复杂度分诊机制（L0/L1 单点任务直接敏捷执行，L2 复杂任务严格遵循“澄清访谈 -> 架构规划 -> 并发子代理派发 -> 双层严格验收”标准流）；设定严格的提问预算控制（单轮最多 4 问、总计最多 3 轮、影响面排序、假设先行），杜绝无效拉扯；任务状态权威沉淀于 `todo_write`，杜绝浮躁的敷衍式交付。\n- **新建会话老虎机拨杆与炫酷中奖特效（Composer Slot Lever）**：在新建会话输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧，精心打造了一台复古老虎机拨杆控件。下拉拨杆（支持鼠标拖拽、单击或键盘快捷操作）即可一键为当前新建会话装配梁神模式，拉下命中即触发绚丽的中奖粒子特效（闪光、冲击环、火花粒子与专属彩蛋横幅）；上推即可平滑切回默认模式。拨杆自适应全局主题色彩，且在会话开始后自动隐藏，丝滑灵动，极具极客趣味。\n\n详细机制、评测数据与高级配置参数见 [dsh-liangshen README](packages/dsh-liangshen/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 智能体小队（Agent Squads · 可复用成员定义与整队协同运行）\n\n通过侧边栏“智能体”入口进入。智能体小队（`dsh-agents`）把跨会话复用的专业 AI 角色与团队编制沉淀为宿主权威账本：每个小队管理一组有序成员，既可按需单独点播某个成员开启专属会话，也可一键发起整队 Agent Teams 协同攻坚：\n\n- **可复用小队与成员定义（Reusable Squad & Member Definitions）**：小队支持配置名称、职责描述、可选绑定工作区与整队运行的 Lead 预设；每位成员独立钉住显示名称、Agent 预设（如梁神模式或研究小队预设）、沙箱权限、模型路由、推理思考强度与成员简报（Brief）。成员简报仅通过系统提示词段注入该成员专属会话，绝不污染首条用户消息或普通对话会话。\n- **整队 Agent Teams 协同运行与实时投影（Whole-Squad Runs & Live Projection）**：一键启动整队运行，小队名册与任务目标经 `team:squad` 系统提示词上下文直达 `<小队名> / Lead` 会话；Lead 按成员钉住的预设、权限与模型动态孵化专属 Teammate，任一钉子无法兑现立即 Fail-Closed 报错而不静默降级。前端直接读取共享会话存储中的 `agentTeam` 投影（`stateVersion` 4），实时呈现 Lead 与各 Teammate 的角色、执行阶段与启动异常，全程无需轮询。\n- **10 项全会话定义管理与启动工具（10 Model-Facing Management & Launch Tools）**：向宿主全体会话注册 `squads_list`、`squads_read`、`squads_create`、`squads_update`、`squads_delete`、`squad_member_add`、`squad_member_update`、`squad_member_remove`、`squads_run_member`、`squads_run_squad` 共 10 项进程内工具，支持对话中的 Agent 自主编排小队、点播单成员会话或发起整队运行，删除操作强制要求 `confirm: true` 安全确认。\n- **原子账本持久化与同源运行时避让（Atomic Ledger & Runtime Coexistence）**：定义与最新 200 条运行记录经临时文件 fsync + 原子 rename 持久化于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-agents/ledger.json`（由 `ledger.json.lock` 保证单进程独占，损坏账本原样保留绝不覆盖）；当宿主已挂载官方 `agentTeams` 服务时自动避让内置团队运行时并无缝复用官方状态投影。\n\n详细契约、工具表与安全模型见 [dsh-agents README](packages/dsh-agents/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 实时浏览器视图（Browser View · 右侧栏 CDP 实时投屏与网页自动化）\n\n在会话右侧栏标签条或引导胶囊中打开。实时浏览器视图（`dsh-browser-view`）为 Agent 提供一个由宿主驱动、用户可在聊天旁侧实时观看的受控 Chromium 浏览器标签页，实现前端开发验证、视觉巡检与网页交互的全程可视化闭环：\n\n- **右侧栏 CDP 实时投屏与保活挂载（Right-Docked Screencast & Keep-Mounted View）**：注册专属右侧栏标签页类型 `browser-view`（与官方 `browser` 标签页和平共处），通过单条 WebSocket 实时绘制 CDP `Page.startScreencast` 画面帧、当前 URL、标题与 Agent 最近一次操作摘要；切换标签 chip 时保持挂载不断连，仅在页面变化时推流。\n- **默认隔离 Chromium 与真实已登录浏览器接管（Isolated Chromium & Real Browser Attach）**：默认惰性拉起带有一次性临时配置目录与随机调试端口的无头 Chromium（固定 1280x800 视口，访问本机 DSH Web GUI 遇 401 鉴权时自动内存取票完成登录）；开启 `realBrowserEnabled` 后可通过本地回环 CDP 端点（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:9222`）直接接管用户以非默认数据目录启动的 Chrome 或 Edge，直接在既有登录态下操作全部标签页，绝不导出或复制任何 Cookie。\n- **11 项受控浏览器交互工具（11 Agent Browser Tools）**：提供 `browser_navigate`、`browser_click`、`browser_type`、`browser_press`、`browser_scroll`、`browser_snapshot`、`browser_screenshot`、`browser_console`、`browser_network`、`browser_tabs`、`browser_close` 完整工具链；`browser_snapshot` 输出深度优先编号（`ref`）与坐标框的 DOM 结构树供精准点击与输入，每个标签页独立维护控制台日志与网络请求环形缓冲区。\n- **高保真无损区域截图与证据入列（Lossless Region Screenshots & Transcript Evidence）**：`browser_screenshot` 默认输出无损 PNG 并经宿主附件服务直接写入对话轨迹；支持传入与 `browser_snapshot` 同坐标系的 `clip: { x, y, width, height }` 进行局部区域裁剪（默认 2x 渲染倍率，可选 1x/2x/3x），显著提升模型视觉 Token 细节分辨率，越界裁剪或连接失败均显式报错而不静默回退。\n\n详细配置、真实浏览器启动参数与安全边界见 [dsh-browser-view README](packages/dsh-browser-view/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 手机 App 远程访问（Mobile Remote · 原生手机 App 接入）\n\n在 profile 中安装 [`@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge`](packages/dsh-remote-bridge/README.zh.md) 插件并重启服务后，点击侧边栏底部的二维码图标（aria-label 为「配对 iPhone」）打开配对面板。使用手机 App 扫码即可直接开始使用。\n\n配对面板具备本地安全保护，令牌路由（`/remote-bridge/pair/token`）带有回环门控，仅允许在本机浏览器中访问（非本机访问返回 403）。面板生成的配对码为一次性凭据，有效期为 30 秒，点击「重新取码」将作废上一张配对码。二维码编码包含服务地址与令牌的文档（URL 形如 `wss://<origin>/ios/v1?token=...`），手机 App 扫码后即可同时获取服务地址与鉴权令牌。\n\n网络接入协议面仅暴露 `/ios/v1` 一个 WebSocket 端点，隧道与局域网转发均指向仅放行该路径的入站闸门，公网无法直接访问 Web GUI 路由。服务地址按实时状态（中继租约或运行中的隧道）、环境变量 `DSH_REMOTE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 以及局域网转发器实际监听地址的顺序解析。默认配置下公网可用（中继默认开启、隧道默认关闭、局域网转发默认关闭）；若需在局域网内直连，需在插件配置中开启局域网转发。\n\n[iOS App 还在内测，欢迎来 Discord 交流](https://discord.gg/nBy28kjun)。\n\n### 远程连接（SSH Ops · Web 终端、SFTP 传输与集群运维）\n\n通过侧边栏“SSH”入口打开远程运维面板（详见 [dsh-ssh README](packages/dsh-ssh/README.zh.md)）。支持密钥与密码认证，可一键导入本地 `~/.ssh/config` 主机列表；配置数据安全保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 中。面板提供以下操作能力：\n\n- **Web 终端**：基于 xterm.js 的完整远程交互终端，支持实时输出与窗口自适应；\n- **文件传输**：集成 SFTP 上传与下载功能，提供进度提示并支持可视化浏览远程目录；\n- **端口转发**：支持建立本地到远程内部服务的加密隧道（如内网数据库、后端 API），默认仅监听 127.0.0.1 安全地址；\n- **集群并发执行**：支持多主机批量命令执行，并可通过别名、运行环境或标签进行过滤；\n- **Agent 直连调用**：智能体与面板共享主机配置，在会话中发出指令即可委派 Agent 执行远程巡检与运维命令。\n\n### 使用统计（Usage Statistics · Token 消耗追踪、余额预警与 Token 银行）\n\n在“设置 > 使用统计”中集中查看 token 消耗数据、供应商余额以及编程套餐额度，支持自动定时刷新与手动即时查询。\n\n- **用量明细**：查看每日输入、输出与缓存用量，按不同供应商与模型细分展示，并提供最近 30 天消费趋势；支持的供应商提供账户余额查询，针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费与账单估算。\n- **个人套餐追踪**：实时展示 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、Codex / ChatGPT 等平台编程套餐的使用比例与重置周期。\n- **Token 银行**：所有 provider 每消耗 100 万 tokens 铸造 1 鲸元，以“鲸元券”形式展示台账周期内的累计 token 与调用指标，支持保存票券卡片与系统级分享。\n- **桌面宠物联动**：安装宠物插件后，可通过桌面悬浮挂件的气泡提示直接查看当前会话供应商的额度、余额或今日消耗。\n\n统计自插件首次启用起计，不回填历史数据；鲸元券统计台账窗口内所有 provider 的 tokens（消费行仍只来自 DeepSeek 官方余额观测）。支持的供应商列表与配置细节见 [dsh-usage README](packages/dsh-usage/README.zh.md)。\n\n![DeepSeek Token 用量统计与 Token 银行 — API 消耗追踪与账单估算](docs/screenshots/35-usage-token-bank.webp)\n\n### 会话归档管理（Session Archive Manager · 全文检索与生命周期策略）\n\n会话归档管理（`dsh-session-archive`）是专为解决大量长短期会话堆积而设计的集中管理模块，随全家桶安装生效：\n\n- **集中检索与状态筛选**：统一呈现活跃会话、已归档会话、空白会话、子代理派生会话以及无工作区会话，支持按标题、工作区、状态及会话 ID 进行关键词搜索与多维排序；\n- **安全批量操作**：支持跨筛选结果的多选批量归档、批量恢复以及级联物理删除。执行物理删除时系统将明确提示受影响的后代会话数与预计释放空间，大批量删除需二次确认；当前处于运行中或带有运行中子代理的会话受到严格保护，防止误删；\n- **自动化生命周期策略**：提供两个默认关闭的自动化策略：根据最后活跃时间自动归档、根据归档时间自动清理超期数据，支持在启用前进行结果预览与单次手动执行。\n\n删除操作不可逆，所有管理路由严格限制本机回环访问。详细机制见 [dsh-session-archive README](packages/dsh-session-archive/README.zh.md)。\n\n### **俄语语言包**（[`@linxin666/dsh-i18n`](packages/dsh-i18n/README.zh.md)）：集中承载全家族插件命名空间的俄语（`ru`）多语言字典支持。\n\n### 皮肤\n\n经典的 Blue Fantasy 蓝色幻想是随皮肤插件内置的默认主题：深邃的靛蓝色调贯穿全局，搭配半透明毛玻璃面板与定制鲸鱼插画，在暗色模式下具有优秀的视觉沉浸感。其他精美皮肤与 Wallpaper Engine 动态壁纸由皮肤插件统一管理，可直接在[创意工坊](https://dsh-market.com)在线预览、试穿与一键安装。\n\n![DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤 — Blue Fantasy 暗黑沉浸风格预览](docs/screenshots/17-skin-blue-fantasy-dark.png)\n\n## 快速上手\n\n### 系统要求\n\n- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness 且 `dsh web` 可正常启动。\n- npm 安装方式无需额外环境；若从源码仓库构建，需要 Node.js >= 24.9 与 pnpm 环境。\n\n### 三步上手（npm 安装，推荐）\n\n- **DSH Web CLI（现有浏览器服务）**：\n  1. 先完成三项构建脚本审批（见“安装排障”），再安装聚合包：`dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-all@latest`\n  2. 重启 `dsh web` 服务，侧边栏将自动呈现各插件入口\n  3. 打开“设置 > 插件配置”按需开关插件，或在皮肤面板选用主题\n- **官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop）**：\n  1. 打开官方桌面客户端，进入“设置 → 插件”页面\n  2. 在插件安装框中输入 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` 并确认安装\n  3. 重启客户端，即可在侧边栏与“设置”中使用各插件功能\n\n> 若仅需要皮肤功能，可单独安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center`。若因包管理器门禁安装到旧版本，请参阅后文“安装排障”。\n\n### 从 GitHub 仓库直接安装\n\n仓库根目录声明了标准 `dsh.bundle` 装配清单，支持直接通过仓库地址安装，无需手动克隆代码与构建：\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add github:zhu1090093659/dsh-web\n# 或使用完整 git 地址：dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git\n```\n\n该方式与直接从 npm 安装聚合包效果等价，二者择其一即可。请勿同时通过两种方式安装，以免出现 entry id 冲突。\n\n### 从仓库安装（开发调试）\n\n如需二次开发或调试插件，可按以下步骤从源码构建（要求 Node.js >= 24.9 与 pnpm）：\n\n```sh\n# 1. 克隆源码仓库\ngit clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git\ncd dsh-web\n\n# 2. 安装项目依赖（自动对齐宿主 @deepseek-ai SDK 软链）并构建全包\npnpm run deps:install\npnpm build\n\n# 3. 将本地包软链挂载至 web profile（建议先链接所有子包再注册聚合包）\nnode scripts/link-profile.mjs\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-web-all\n\n# 4. 重新启动 dsh web 服务\ndsh web\n```\n\n> 提示：profile 目录未配置为 pnpm workspace，聚合包内部的 `workspace:*` 依赖在解析时会尝试回退拉取 npm 线上版本。若线上包存在版本差异，请先运行 `node scripts/link-profile.mjs` 确保全部子包均指向本地构建产物。\n\n### 单独安装某个插件\n\n如果不需要安装全家桶，可根据实际需求单独安装各个功能模块：\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board@latest            # 任务看板\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-liangshen@latest                       # 梁神模式（极简预设与 PTC 传输）\ndsh plugin --profile web 同步扩展\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board-team@latest       # 任务看板云端团队协作扩展\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-task-board-remote@latest               # 任务看板手机远端面扩展\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-ssh@latest                             # 远程连接（SSH 终端与集群运维）\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-usage@latest plugin --profile web remove @linxin666/dsh-web-all`，完成后重启 `dsh web` 即可恢复纯净状态。\n\n技术实现细节与挂载原理解析见 [docs/plugins.md](docs/plugins.md)。\n\n### 安装排障\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>展开查看常见安装与构建排障方案</strong></summary>\n\n<br>\n\n> **pnpm 严格依赖隔离导致模块找不到**：pnpm 的 isolated 模式默认仅将聚合包放置在顶层，部分子包可能被嵌套收敛，导致 `dsh web` 启动时报错 `Cannot find package '@linxin666/dsh-...'`。若遇到此情况，可在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中添加配置 `nodeLinker: hoisted`（或 `public-hoist-pattern: ['@linxin666/*']`）后重新安装。\n\n> **构建脚本被拦截 (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS)**：这三项审批必须在首次 add 之前就位。正确顺序是重置 profile（官方 `--from-default-profile web`）或换新 profile，在 `<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里把三项写成映射，再执行 add：\n>\n> ```yaml\n> allowBuilds:\n>   cloudflared: true\n>   cpu-features: true\n>   ssh2: true\n> ```\n>\n> 必须写成上面的映射形式：列表形式会被 pnpm 改写成 `'0': cloudflared` 之类的占位条目，重跑时还会回退已解析的包（`Packages: -10`）。装失败后补审批重跑会 exit 0，但 `dsh.profile.bundles` 仍无该行：静默半挂载，重跑修不回来，需要先 remove 再 add。已带审批的存量 profile 升级不受影响。\n\n> **pnpm 11 发布时间门禁问题**：在包版本发布后的短时间内，pnpm 11 的默认安全策略（`minimumReleaseAge`）可能会尝试回退拉取旧版本。建议在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中排除相关命名空间以确保获取最新版本：\n>\n> ```yaml\n> minimumReleaseAgeExclude:\n>   - '@linxin666/*'\n> ```\n\n</details>\n\n## 兼容性与运行环境\n\ndsh-web 针对主流操作系统、现代化浏览器及网络拓扑进行了深度工程调优与兼容性保障：\n\n| 维度 | 支持范围与技术规格 |\n| --- | --- |\n| 宿主运行环境 | DeepSeek Harness 常见问题\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>安装重启后，侧边栏未显示插件入口？</strong></summary>\n\n请首先检查插件是否正确安装至 `web` profile（命令需包含 `--profile web`），并通过 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 验证配置层是否已成功挂载。注意仅刷新网页无法加载新模块，必须彻底重启 `dsh web` 后端服务进程。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>定时任务为何未能按时触发执行？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，无需保持前端浏览器页面打开。若宿主进程退出、系统关机或整机进入深度睡眠，错过的触发时间点将遵循跳过策略处理，不执行回填补跑；若任务到达触发点时上一轮仍在运行，会自动顺延至下一个周期。若需要允许息屏但防止主机自动睡眠，可开启任务看板自带的电源保护选项。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>手机 App 配对后为何没有收到流式推送？</strong></summary>\n\n手机 App 通过协议 v1 的 WebSocket 通道与宿主通信。隧道或中继中断期间流式更新暂停，网络恢复后连接会自动重连；更新节奏的差异主要来自广域网往返延迟。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>试穿主题皮肤不满意如何还原？</strong></summary>\n\n皮肤面板提供免落盘试穿功能：点击试穿即刻在当前界面生效预览，离开面板或关闭预览会自动恢复初始外观；只有显式点击“应用”按钮才会将主题配置写入磁盘，可放心预览各类主题。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>是否可以仅使用主题皮肤或某个单一插件？</strong></summary>\n\n完全支持。若仅需要视觉定制，直接安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center` 即可；若仅需特定功能，参考“单独安装某个插件”章节直接安装对应 npm 包即可。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>已安装全家桶的前提下，能否额外独立安装某个子插件？</strong></summary>\n\n可以。聚合包内部的插件注册标识均统一带有 `web-ui-` 前缀（例如 `web-ui-usage`），与独立包的原生标识（如 `usage`）相互独立，不会产生 loader entry 重复冲突。宿主服务对同类插件会自动去重。通常情况下安装全家桶即可满足完整需求，无需重复安装单个子包。\n\n</details>\n\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何通过手机 App 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness？是否必须在同一 Wi-Fi 下？</strong></summary>\n\n手机远程访问由协议 v1 支撑，不要求必须处于同一 Wi-Fi。默认配置下插件已开启公网中继服务，在电脑端点击侧栏底部的二维码图标打开配对面板后，使用手机 App 扫码即可直接通过公网连接；亦可配置 Cloudflare 隧道。若希望在同一局域网内直连访问，需在插件配置中开启局域网转发并扫码配对。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>关闭浏览器或电脑休眠后，DeepSeek 的定时任务还会继续运行吗？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，关闭浏览器标签页不影响定时任务的触发与执行。但如果整机进入深度睡眠或关机，宿主进程将暂停运行，离线期间错过的触发点会遵循跳过策略处理。若希望保持无人值守后台自动化，可在任务看板设置中开启“电源保护”选项，该选项会阻止系统因空闲进入休眠（允许显示器正常熄灭），确保定时任务准时触发。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何查看和监控 DeepSeek 及其他模型 API 的 Token 消耗与账户余额？</strong></summary>\n\n安装使用统计插件后，在“设置 > 使用统计”面板中可查看按日汇总的输入、输出与缓存 Token 数量，支持按模型细分查看 30 天消费趋势。针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费估算；若配置了支持查询余额的供应商 API，插件可定时拉取当前账户剩余额度与重置周期。\n\n</details>\n\n## 已知限制\n\n- 任务看板由后端 Host 进程统一调度，关闭前端标签页不影响任务执行；但若宿主进程停止或操作系统关机睡眠，处于离线期间的触发点将直接跳过不补跑。可选的电源保护仅阻止系统闲置睡眠，无法阻止用户主动合盖、手动休眠或电源切断，技术细节见 [dsh-task-board README](packages/dsh-task-board/README.zh.md)。\n- SSH 凭据（密码与私钥口令）保存在本地 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 文件中（文件权限为 0600）；在网络中断重连时可能重新发送非幂等命令，终端输出保持原样返回不执行脱敏，安全规范见 [dsh-ssh README](packages/dsh-ssh/README.zh.md)。\n- 手机 App 流式交互经隧道或中继转发，广域网往返延迟叠加在每次更新上；固定域名中继比裸快速隧道多一跳，两者均可使用。\n- 从源码构建全仓需要 Node.js >= 24.9 与 pnpm 工具链，直接从 npm 安装不受此限制。\n\n##       "path": "packages/dsh-remote-web-ui/README.zh.md",
      "content": "# dsh-remote-web-ui · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 手机端与跨设备浏览器远程控制插件\n\n[English](README.md) | 中文\n\n> **弃用声明**：`@linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui` 已弃用，后续由 [@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge](../dsh-remote-bridge/README.zh.md) 承接。本插件已从 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` 聚合包中摘除（老 profile 行通过 tombstone 导出与 `retiredPlugins` 登记静默跳过为 no-op），并计划在下一版本中正式删除。过渡期内独立安装（`dsh plugin --profile <name> add @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui`）仍可正常使用。浏览器远程控制能力已由手机 App（@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge）取代，本包不再提供远程访问功能。\n>\n> - **已迁往 `@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge` 的能力**：接入栈（中继身份登记、租约 claim/release 控制面、快速/命名双隧道连接器、Durable Object 会合点连接器、cloudflared 进程生命周期与孤儿进程清理、Cloudflare 命名隧道 ingress 端口同步、局域网转发器、宿主通配绑定探测与主机防火墙管理）。\n> - **随本插件一起下线的能力**：浏览器侧远程控制面（配对 cookie 门控、`/api/pair` 路由族、门控 `/remote` 代理通道以及手机浏览器竖屏触控适配层）。\n> - **并存已知风险**：若与 `@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge` 在同一 profile 中并存，切勿同时开启两端的中继（两者按 profile 共用同一中继身份，两侧同时启用会竞争 Durable Object 会合点连接，且新桥以 `relay=false` 挂载时会主动撤销该身份的注册行并释放租约）。\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui?style=flat-square\" alt=\"Version\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.2--rc.1-4c6ef5?style=flat-square&labelColor=454a54\" alt=\"DSH\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square\" alt=\"License\">\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>DeepSeek Harness（DSH）官方 Web GUI 与桌面客户端手机与跨设备远程控制中心</strong><br>\n  <em>手机扫码即连 · 跨设备 PC 浏览器访问 · 竖屏触控手势优化 · Cloudflare 公网隧道 · 安全设备配对</em>\n</p>\n\n> 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI 与官方桌面客户端提供共享**同一份界面**的远程访问：在设置按钮旁的二维码配对手机或另一台电脑，两端运行的都和本机一样是官方 Web GUI——手机获得注入的竖屏触控适配，电脑获得完整桌面；准入基于限时配对令牌与可撤销设备会话。设置卡片可将服务绑定到局域网，可选 Cloudflare 快速隧道触达公网——并由一个永不变化的固定主机名前置，手机的书签与配对零配置跨重启有效。\n\n本仓库是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的外部插件包，为单一双面包：host 半区持有配对令牌、设备会话、`/api/pair` 路由族、门控 `/remote` 通道、局域网绑定开关；浏览器半区渲染侧栏底部、设置按钮旁的远程访问入口、带二维码的配对面板、实时设备状态、已授权设备列表、设置卡片，以及官方界面之上的竖屏触控适配层。\n\n## 功能\n\n- **入口**：展开侧栏与窄栏中设置按钮旁的手机图标；tooltip 与可访问标签为「远程访问」。\n- **面板**：「远程访问」标题、「设备配对」卡片（状态区「等待设备连接」+ 状态徽标）、大二维码、带复制按钮的配对链接、停止 / 刷新二维码操作，以及已授权设备列表（可保存的设备名，未命名时回退到按 User-Agent 推断的名称；在线/离线、最近活动时间、逐设备重命名与取消配对，以及同 User-Agent 记录的一键合并）。承载凭据的设备 id 与原始 User-Agent 值绝不渲染。手机与电脑共用同一条限时链接：在令牌过期或刷新二维码之前，该链接可为多台设备完成配对，每台各自生成独立设备会话。\n- **手机侧**：扫码后以限时令牌绑定并重载进入**官方 Web GUI**——不存在会漂移的第二套界面。手机竖屏时插件在运行中的界面上注入触控适配层（见下文）。接受链路不依赖 cookie（`/pair-accept` → `/pair-app`）：官方应用壳由插件直接交付，手机全程不需要 harness 浏览器认证 cookie。随后由重开 service worker（https 源）接管此后对 `/` 的导航——来自历史、书签或标签恢复的重开直接回到应用，而不是 401 死路（见安全模型）。\n- **电脑侧**：同一链接在另一台电脑的浏览器里打开完整桌面 Web GUI，流量走门控 `/remote` 通道；未配对的电脑看到引导式拦截页（含手动粘贴配对令牌输入框），其后没有任何工作区数据。\n- **安全**：同时只有一枚有效令牌（刷新二维码使旧链接失效；链接在其有效期窗口内可重复配对——扫码在浏览器间转手也能完成配对；令牌会过期）。停止会撤销所有配对设备与当前令牌——`/remote` 通道在下一次请求即切断它们。配对是本插件对 `/remote` 通道的访问控制；web server 自身保持回环绑定，因此局域网浏览器经本插件门控的 `/remote` 网关进入应用（客户端把传输改写到那里），而不是走原生 `/api`——对局域网权威，harness 的 Host 围栏会返回 403（见安全模型）。回环（127.0.0.1）继续直接使用 `/api`；本机应用交付的页面（桌面外壳的 `dsh-app://app/`、`file:` 页面）同样如此——配对链接只能经网络到达。配对设备是**完全控制凭据**（见安全模型）。\n- **局域网访问开关（运行时转发器）**：设置卡片启动一个转发器，不改写任何文件。web server 保持回环绑定，转发器在本机局域网 IPv4 地址、同一端口上监听，把每个请求——HTTP 与 WebSocket upgrade 一视同仁——转发到 `127.0.0.1:<端口>`。`--host`/`--port` 恢复常规语义：显式 `dsh web --host <局域网地址>` 照旧可用，此时转发器让出该端口。开关在进程运行期间即时生效：无需重启，也不写 profile。本机没有局域网 IPv4 地址时转发器保持关闭，卡片会如实说明。同时维护对应的主机防火墙规则（Windows Defender 经 netsh；Linux firewalld/ufw/iptables；其他平台报告防火墙不受管），并展示运行中的绑定、可达局域网地址、与宿主自身 `localBindHost` 并列的转发器状态（`forward { listening, host, port, reason, error }`）以及防火墙状态。\n- **实时状态**：桌面徽标实时切换为已连接；`/api` 姿态探测报告 SDK 栅栏仍敞开的 `/api` 来源；隧道启动期间面板显示自动隧道状态。\n- **本席位不再有更新入口**：曾与该席位并列的家族自更新包已移除，插件更新改由官方插件页的版本检查承担，因此关闭远程访问、甚至禁用本插件，都不会把更新入口一起带走。\n- **桌面端底栏一行**：宽栏下脚部动作占用者不再各自成行，而是与官方「设置」触发器共用一行，设置按钮不再独占整行；其他脚部块（用量速览卡、其它插件的块）仍各占一整行，56px 栏轨保持官方原有的堆叠脚部。\n\n## 移动端适配层\n\n官方桌面布局在 1024px 以下已自动折叠侧栏。在此基础上，视口为竖屏 + 粗指针 + 宽度不足 1100px 时插件注入：\n\n- 以 CSS Modules **语义后缀**为键的样式表（`[class$=\"_composerSeat\"]`），官方重构只改 hash 时选择器依然存活：折叠栏 44px 触控目标、16px 输入（防 iOS 聚焦缩放）、composer 的 safe-area 内边距、消息列表与侧栏的紧凑字号、设置弹窗纵向布局、PlanReview 卡片全宽；\n- **可拖拽小鲸鱼按钮**作为折叠侧栏的展开入口（位置记忆；接到官方 `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`），侧栏展开时隐藏；\n- **手势**：左滑收起侧栏、会话区右滑展开；长按会话行打开与桌面省略号相同的操作菜单；点会话行或侧栏外任意位置再次收起；\n- **触控输入行为**：Enter 只换行（发送走发送按钮）、抑制程序化 composer 聚焦（不乱弹键盘）、隐藏官方 tooltip 气泡（触屏上会残留）；\n- **移动端插件范围**：适配层激活时，右侧详情列与面向桌面的工具界面（SSH 终端、技能中心、任务看板、git graph、宠物、使用统计）一律隐藏——以 L2 语义根（`data-dsh-plugin`）为键，归属由声明方插件负责，官方类名变动也不会复活它们。这些是渲染抑制；客户端 bundle 仍会加载。激活时还会经官方 `ctx.layout.closeDetails()` 真正关闭详情面板。\n- **手动退出**：`sessionStorage.dsh-remote-force-desktop = 1` 关闭整个适配层；横屏、桌面与宽视口永不触碰。\n\n配对远程桌面同时运行在 **host 模式**：在本 harness 线上，「配置面仅限本机」的行为是客户端分支（`connection.isLoopback`），通道 boot 脚本在一切 boot entry 之前安装传输钩子（`__DSH_TRANSPORT__.ownsHost = true`）。host 模式由**服务器授予**：只有当设备门控的应用落地页（`/pair-app`）在 boot 补丁之前发布了授权标记时才会安装该钩子，因此交付给未配对浏览器（围栏被打开的部署）的应用壳永远不会自称机器主人。设置、凭据、Agent 预设与产出物在手机上与桌面完全一致——所有调用仍走门控 `/remote` 通道。三个控制面保持物理本地：`/api/pair/*`、`/api/update/*` 与 `/api/plugin-manager/*`。\n\n## 环境要求\n\n- DSH 安装的 `dsh` CLI 需支持 profile（`dsh --profile`、`dsh plugin`）——本包依托的 profile/bundle 机制。\n- 局域网使用：在设置卡片打开**局域网访问**——它立刻在本机当前的局域网 IPv4 地址、web server 的端口上监听，因此网络变化后把开关关一次再打开即可；或以 `dsh web --host <本机的局域网地址>` 启动。通配的 `--host 0.0.0.0` 只在仍接受它的宿主上有效；DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 及以后会直接拒绝。默认 `127.0.0.1` 绑定时面板会显示明确说明而非失效二维码——除非已配置公网地址（见下文「通过互联网远程访问」），此时二维码随处可达而无需重绑，随后落地页会把同一网络里的手机从隧道移到局域网源。面板的铸造/停止端点设计上仅限回环：在局域网地址打开的桌面浏览器会看到「配对面板仅限本机使用」横幅。\n- 一键公网隧道（`autoTunnel`）所需的 `cloudflared` 平台二进制随包分发（postinstall 下载；跳过 postinstall 的安装方式由运行时下载兜底）。无需用户侧工具、账号或域名。\n- 同一二进制也支撑固定域名命名隧道模式（`tunnelToken`）：公共主机名永久不变，手机配对一次后书签与配对 Cookie 跨重启持续有效，无需重新配对。\n\n## 安装\n\n安装全家桶聚合包 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all`（全部插件与皮肤）或单独安装本插件：\n\n```sh\n# 推荐：直接从 npm 安装\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui@latest\n\n# 或从仓库（开发循环）\ngit clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git\ncd dsh-web\npnpm install && pnpm -r build\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-remote-web-ui\n```\n\n重启 profile（`dsh web`），然后打开侧栏底部的手机图标。插件的 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入单一插件行，同时挂载两个半区。\n\n> `github:<org>/<repo>` 安装适用于包位于仓库根的独立仓库（`prepare` 脚本在安装期构建 `lib/`；pnpm ≥10 会阻止，需把打印的 key 复制进 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` `allowBuilds` 后重试）。monorepo 子包使用上面的 `link:` 形式。\n\n## 使用\n\n1. 打开设置卡片（设置 → Web 插件 → 远程访问）并打开**局域网访问**；卡片展示运行中的绑定、与宿主自身 `localBindHost` 并列的转发器状态、防火墙状态与可达局域网地址，本机没有局域网地址时还会说明局域网入口为何关闭。转发器立即启停、无需重启：本机网络变化后把开关关一次再打开，它才会跟随新的地址。\n2. 启动 `dsh web`，点手机图标，面板铸造一枚全新的限时二维码。\n3. 手机扫码（或打开复制的链接）：设备完成配对，进入由插件不依赖 cookie 交付的**官方 Web GUI**（`/pair-accept` → `/pair-app`），并重载到 `/`。链接指向公网基址时，落地页还会探测对外广告的局域网源（每个候选向 `/pair-ping` 发一次短超时的 no-cors 请求），把手机切到第一个应答的源，并在会话内记住该决定：它所在的那张公网页全程可用，探测从不阻塞配对；不在同一网络的手机原地不动。手机上竖屏适配层已生效——与桌面同布局、同实时状态。此后的重开（历史、书签）直接回到应用（https 源；见安全模型）。\n4. **改为配对电脑**：复制同一链接，在另一台电脑的浏览器打开。相同往返后完整 Web GUI 在彼处经门控 `/remote` 通道运行；未配对电脑看到引导式拦截页，其后没有数据。一枚令牌配一台设备；下一台设备请刷新二维码。\n5. 桌面徽标实时切换为已连接；设备列表列出已配对设备并支持逐设备取消配对，停止则全部撤销。\n6. 配对有效期、设备上限、局域网栅栏策略（`requirePairingForLan`）、公网地址、自动隧道、固定域名中继与命名隧道令牌都在同一设置卡片配置。走哪张网络无需选择：二维码链接固定指向公网基址，手机与本机同网时由落地页自行切到局域网源；若该探测误判，用仅补丁可见的 `pairingSource`（`auto` | `public` | `lan`）钉住选择——卡片没有它的控件，卡片保存不会改动它。\n\n## 通过互联网远程访问（隧道）\n\n隧道进程重启（最常见的原因是移动网络闪断重连）过去会让插件在隧道离开 `running` 的瞬间把公网主机移出配对栅栏，于是二维码上仍显示着的地址会返回 403——连有意公开的 `/api/pair/status` 也不例外（issue #1547）。命名隧道的固定主机名与已注册的中继源本来就不会变，现在在整个重连期间保持受信任；快速隧道的上一个地址保留 60 秒宽限期（边缘可能仍在投递手机已经建立的连接），只有到期仍未恢复才彻底失效。\n\n### 一键公网隧道（推荐）\n\n在设置卡片打开**自动公网隧道**（autoTunnel）。插件运行自己的 Cloudflare 快速隧道（`cloudflared` 随包分发），把铸造的公网 URL 动态喂给二维码与配对栅栏，并同步姿态探测——手机随时随地都能配对。开启期间忽略下方手动公网地址与命名隧道令牌。铸造的域名是临时的，每次 `dsh web` 重启都会变化——下方的固定域名中继会把手机的访问源钉在固定地址上，重启不再需要重新扫码。宿主异常退出、来不及拆掉隧道时，`cloudflared` 子进程会留在系统里；因此每次启动都会回收自己记录的那个子进程（pid 与命令行都要逐字符匹配），绝不碰任何不是它自己启动的进程。\n\n### 固定域名中继（默认开启；配对一次，重启不再重配）\n\n快速隧道运行期间，插件会额外把当前隧道地址注册到 dsh-market 中继注册表，并把二维码重建在一个固定源上——`https://<id>.dsh-market.com`——每个 profile 首次运行铸造一次，存放在 `$DSH_HOME/remote-web-ui-registry/`。主机名永不变化，手机的书签与配对 Cookie 在 `dsh web` 重启后依然有效，且不需要 Cloudflare 账号、控制台操作或自己的域名。\n\n- 注册以密钥认证：插件在身份旁铸造一个 256 位密钥，每次隧道启动（含崩溃重启）以退避重试同步映射。注册表不可达时，该次会话的二维码回退为裸快速隧道地址，并在面板中说明。\n- 实例离线时，手机打开固定源会看到明确的「实例离线——稍后刷新即可，无需重新配对」页面，而不是死链。\n- 在设置卡片关闭**固定域名中继**（relay）可让部署完全留在临时源上；注册表行会立即删除。信任说明：中继流量经由 dsh-market 边缘（由包作者运营的 Cloudflare Worker）转发——见安全模型。\n- 中继控制面是附加式的：只要中继开启且 web 服务端口已绑定，插件就向 `https://dsh-market.com/api/relay/claim` 认领一条命名隧道租约——worker 找到或创建名为 `dsh-relay-<id>` 的隧道、写入 ingress（含必需的 catch-all 规则）与一条精确的代理 CNAME，并把该实例专属的隧道 Token 交回插件。被运营方翻到桥接传输的租约在账户里不收敛任何东西：该次 claim 不建隧道、不写 ingress、不建 CNAME，一次 Cloudflare API 调用都不发，只保留主机名与桥接授权，应答里也没有 `tunnel` 块——桥的数据面是实例自己的 Durable Object，既没有东西要建，也不占账户那 1 000 条隧道配额。插件据此在同一条主机名上运行命名连接器，与快速连接器并行；控制面应答的 `mode` 决定手机由哪一条服务，切换与回滚都不需要重启插件。认领失败不是致命的：快速隧道与注册表给出的源照旧服务，认领按封顶退避重试（`502` 会附带 `retryAfterMs`）。关闭开关只 `release` 租约（隧道与 DNS 记录保留，重新开启瞬时恢复），只有显式 `retire` 与 90 天未见的 cron 回收才会删除源。\n- 桥接传输共用同一条租约：插件用租约密钥在 `Authorization` 头里连接 `wss://dsh-market.com/api/relay/bridge?id=<id>`，把每条桥接请求与手机的 WebSocket 都从这一个套接字上服务，转发公网源作为 `Host`，绝不改成它拨号的回环权威。控制面应答 `mode=quick` 时它空转；没有连接器附着时 Worker 在同一次请求内回落到快速路径，并在应答上标注 `x-relay-fallback: no-connector`。认领是唯一携带桥接授权的应答，因此它不等快速隧道：由桥接服务的实例即使在 `autoTunnel` 关闭时也能连到自己的对象。连接器把状态写进 `$DSH_HOME/remote-web-ui-relay-bridge.json`——状态、实例、端点、本地上游与最近一次拨号错误——于是「连接器从未附着」不必读宿主日志也能查到。\n\n### 固定域名命名隧道（自带域名）\n\n上方的中继已经把手机的访问源固定在共享的 dsh-market 子域名上。Cloudflare 命名隧道适合希望主机名落在**自己域名**下的部署：公共主机名永久固定，手机的书签与配对 Cookie 在 `dsh web` 重启后依然有效——配对一次，终身使用（会话空闲超过 `idleExpireMs` 除外）。\n\n1. 在 Cloudflare 控制台创建一个 Tunnel，并把一个公共主机名（如 `dsh.example.com`）映射到 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`（`dsh web` 监听的端口）。\n2. 复制隧道 Token，粘贴到设置卡片的**固定域名隧道令牌**（tunnelToken）。\n3. 把同一主机名填入**公网地址**（publicBaseUrl）。Token 本身不携带主机名，缺了这一步隧道不会启动，并会给出缺失警告。\n\n插件随后以与快速隧道相同的生命周期管理运行 `cloudflared tunnel run --token`：二进制随包分发，意外退出自动退避重启，运行中的隧道每 60 秒探测一次公网地址，连续两次失败即经同一条重启路径重铸隧道；姿态探测持续审计该固定主机的 `/api` 围栏。Token 作为设置密文存储，读取时脱敏。自动快速隧道开启时优先级更高。\n\n`running` 不是终态：连接器失去 Cloudflare 边缘注册后，进程与 metrics 端口仍然活着，而已铸造的域名已经无法解析——插件过去会一直报 `running`，中继继续把手机转发到那个失效地址（Cloudflare 530 / Error 1016），而不是中继自己的离线页（工单 #1723）。就绪看门狗现在把「公网地址不再应答」（DNS 失败、连接被拒、或 530 这类 Cloudflare 5xx）在连续两次探测后判为隧道死亡，走既有退避重启路径重铸隧道并重新注册中继。尚未配对时返回的 `401`/`403` 仍视为存活，因为它是一次正常的往返。\n\n#### 让入口服务端口跟随（可选，仅更新）\n\n命名隧道的主机名永久固定，但它的 ingress 规则里写的是一个固定的本地端口（上面例子中的 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`）。之后 `dsh web` 换到别的端口监听——操作者加了 `--port`、换了 profile、旧端口被另一个实例占用——主机名仍然能解析，却回 502，而本插件这边一切仍以为地址可用。打开**Cloudflare 配置同步**（`ingressSync`），再填账户级 API 令牌（`cfApiToken`）、`cfAccountId` 与 `cfTunnelId`，插件就会让这一个数字跟随宿主实际绑定的端口：\n\n- 启动只读取一次；只有当匹配到的规则服务偏离实际端口时才写入文档；\n- 只改主机名与 `publicBaseUrl` 的 host 精确相等的那条规则的 `service`——因为 API 没有单规则补丁，写入是一次全量 PUT，但写前必须先证明其余所有规则与所有顶层键完全一致；\n- 证明不了就不写、只上报：主机名缺失或重复、任一规则使用通配符、`ingress` 不是数组、缺少 catch-all、服务不是 http(s) 源，或服务托管在本机之外的任何地方——只改回环字面量（127.0.0.0/8、`::1`、`localhost`）与本机自己的局域网地址，邻居的地址或 DNS 名一律不动。插件从不新增规则，也从不补 catch-all；\n- 写完再读回一次。读回不一致即判为冲突并就此停止：同一份隧道文档只有一个写入者，控制台或另一个同步在写它时须由人工核对；\n- 目标就是实际绑定的端口：监听器还没绑定时一个请求都不发（由启动快速隧道的那套静置重规划把端口送到），且从不解析隧道令牌自身的格式。\n\n状态帧上报 `off`/`waiting`/`applied`/`failed`/`conflict`，并附主机名、端口、两个服务字符串与原因，设置卡片把它渲染在开关旁边。快速隧道优先：`autoTunnel` 开启时没有命名隧道可更新，同步状态显示为关闭。\n\n### 手动隧道（自带）\n\n用任意隧道暴露本地端口并填写**公网地址**（publicBaseUrl），例如：\n\n```sh\n# 1. --trusted-host。若只需要隧道访问，\n#    保持局域网绑定关闭。\n```\n\n然后把打印的 URL 填入公网地址。二维码链接由它构造，插件的配对栅栏接受该隧道 authority。姿态探测持续审计 SDK 栅栏对哪些 `/api` 来源保持敞开。\n\n## 开发\n\n在本仓库内工作（无需 DSH 源码 checkout）：\n\n```sh\ncd
